title: Card dispute timelines
text: Raise a card dispute within 30 days of the statement date. Provisional credit is given within 5 working days for unrecognised transactions while the case is investigated.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Failed UPI payments
text: If money is debited but the UPI payment fails, the amount is normally reversed automatically within 2 working days. If it is not, raise a dispute with the transaction reference.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Blocking a lost card
text: Block a lost or stolen card instantly in the app or by calling the 24-hour helpline. Transactions after the block is reported are not the customer's liability.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Foreign transaction fees
text: Card payments in a foreign currency carry a 3.5% markup on the converted amount, shown separately on the statement.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Daily UPI limits
text: The default UPI limit is 1 lakh rupees per day. Customers can lower it in the app; raising it needs branch verification.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Collect requests
text: Navakosh Bank never sends a UPI collect request to refund money. Approving a collect request always sends money out of your account.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: KYC updates
text: Customers must update KYC documents when asked. Accounts with incomplete KYC may have credits restricted until the update is complete.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.

title: Fixed deposit premature withdrawal
text: Fixed deposits withdrawn before maturity earn the rate for the period actually held, minus a 1 percentage point penalty.
note: Fictional policy for a fictional bank; not real banking or regulatory guidance.
